title: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Baba Ganoush Sauce
description: A fusion of Eastern and Chinese flavors, this dish combines the crunch of cabbage with the creaminess of baba ganoush sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic.
Pour the sauce over the cabbage and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the baba ganoush sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
